Subject: Statera trial kickoff — recap & proposed success criteria

Hi Alicia / David —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed plan to keep the trial moving: 

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: Reduce average triage time for inbound clinical queries by 30% while maintaining >=95% answer relevance (manual review).
- Primary evaluation team: David (clinical lead), Alicia (product sponsor), procurement for contract items.

Proposed success criteria (what we will measure)
1) Latency: median response time < 600ms for 512-token prompts under your test load.
2) Relevance: 95% pass rate across the evaluation prompt set (50 representative prompts).
3) Safety/filters: no critical policy flags in the 2000-message sample.
4) Stability: 7-day run without service interruptions at scheduled traffic.

Trial plan & ownership (timeline below)
- Week 0 (this week): staging access + sample data ingestion (owner: Marcus Lin).
- Week 1: model calibration + prompt tuning (owner: Monica Patel; tech lead: Marcus).
- Week 2: user acceptance sampling and relevance review (owner: David Chen).
- Week 3: wrap, learnings, and go/no-go decision (owner: Alicia Torres).

Immediate asks (items to unblock setup)
- Staging network allowlist (IP ranges) — Statera security (procurement)
- Short list of 50 evaluation prompts (David) — ideally by EOD Monday
- Point-of-contact for dataset transfer (Alicia)

Attachments: redwood_poc_success_criteria.pdf (detailed rubric), staging_network_checklist.xlsx

Next steps
- I will loop Marcus to set up a short 30-min deployment window for Tuesday evening PST.
- Please confirm whether your team can deliver the prompt set by Monday EOD.

Thanks — aiming to make the first 72 hours high-velocity so we can validate quick wins.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

Thanks — I'll take point on the staging deploy. A few practical items I need to confirm from your side to avoid a stall: 

1) Network/allowlist: we can do IP allowlisting only (no VPN) for the initial trial; please confirm the CIDR ranges and whether the allowlist will include any NATed egress that could change during testing.
2) Data samples: are you able to provide anonymized examples or do we need to coordinate on a masking pass first? For initial calibration we only need 200–500 anonymized messages.
3) API keys/roles: I'll provision a time-limited key scoped to the trial project; notify me if you want RBAC limits on who in your org can call it.

Proposed deploy window: Tue Dec 8, 8:30–9:30 PM PST — I'll run the deploy, smoke tests, and a simple 100-request pass. If that works, we'll flip traffic to your staging endpoints and hand off to David for relevance sampling.
